text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...It's different than in real life where you
can see
your opponents' faces.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And I can't... put it down...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are there more fighting games? No...
I can't...
Or... maybe just a little...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa stays up all night
playing
fighting games.
